0.label: TOTAL EXTRACT
0.title: Ibotincture™ Total Extract (60 ml)
0.description: The all-rounder-complete, balanced expression of the plant.
0.overview: Total Extract captures the complete character of the plant in a Botanical Concentrate Formula. It is the “all-rounder” of the line, offering a complete and balanced expression.
benefits: Provides holistic balance for mind, body, and spirit.
Encourages clarity, stability, and integration in daily life.
0.chakra: Solar Plexus (Manipura) — supports confidence, willpower, and harmonizing personal energy.
usage: Shake well before use.
Set an intention before each dose.
Start with 5 drops daily; gradually increase up to 20 drops twice/day (after breakfast & lunch).
Follow a 5–7 days on / 2–3 days off cycle.
Can be used in successive rounds.
Discontinue immediately if feeling unwell.
warnings: For educational use only. Not medical advice.
Do not use if pregnant or breastfeeding.
Avoid combining with alcohol, stimulants, or contraindicated medications (particularly those affecting heart rhythm or serotonergic load).
Consult a qualified healthcare provider if you have a heart, liver, or psychiatric condition.
